name: mimin
description: Minimal manager/sidekick coding agent for Bun

scripts.check:version: bun -e 'import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync("package.json", "utf8")); const cli = readFileSync("src/cli.ts", "utf8"); const m = cli.match(/export const CLI_VERSION = "([^"]+)";/); if (!m || m[1] !== pkg.version) throw new Error(`Version mismatch: package.json=${pkg.version} cli.ts=${m ? m[1] : "unknown"}`);'
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outfile dist/index.js --banner='#!/usr/bin/env bun'
